sources.entry: Meme Maker - Meme Maker macOS application for meme creation.

summary.one_liner: A macOS app for adding text to popular meme images, with a searchable meme collection and text styling controls.
summary.what_it_does: Meme Maker lets users pick a meme from a built-in collection or search for one by keyword, such as 'Star Wars' to get related memes. Text can be styled with alignment, text size, text color, shadow, outline width, and outline color. Pinch gestures change text size and Option-drag moves text. The app offers default top and bottom caption text for some memes, and can reopen the last edited image. Images can be saved and opened by drag and drop, and there are one-click sharing options. The README also mentions a help page with inspirational quotes and a link to an iOS version. Its listed dependencies are SSZipArchive, DragDropImageView, and GRVibrantTitlebarWindow.
use_cases: Adding captions to popular meme images
Making custom memes on a Mac
Searching a meme library by topic
Styling meme text with outlines and shadows
notable: Smart meme search that groups related memes by topic
Default caption text for popular meme templates
Companion iOS version mentioned in the README
caveats: The README gives no build or install instructions
Platform is macOS only for this repository; the iOS version is distributed separately
The README does not state a license
